Base revision db97929212bb61ae970b10abac3cc4cd976713ae. L1 KumitateR87 holds the canonical planner seat; a bounded planning data-walk rides the scout item.

# Contract
Lane repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin. Your cwd starts at the fleet root: EVERY path you read, write or cite must be ABSOLUTE. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/<that path>.

- NEVER commit, push, stash, checkout, reset, `git add` or run any mutating jj/git command anywhere. The L1 is the only writer of history. Read-only git (`log`, `show`, `diff`, `ls-tree`, `rev-parse`, `cat-file`, `status`) is fine.
